prompt_preview: Round 1. Proposition: 'AI agents should have persistent memory enabled by default.'. Give your best argument in favour.

response_preview: Persistent memory lets agents accumulate context across sessions, dramatically reducing re-explanation overhead for users. Studies show 40% faster task completion when agents recall prior preferences.

prompt_preview: Round 1. Proposition: 'AI agents should have persistent memory enabled by default.'. Give your best counter-argument.
